mapper.select: select count(1) from mark_user_notice mun where mun.user_id = #{userId} and mun.read_flag = '0'
mapper.insert:
insert into mark_user_notice
user_id, notice_type, title, content, biz_type, biz_id, read_flag, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark,
#{userId}, #{noticeType}, #{title}, #{content}, #{bizType}, #{bizId}, #{readFlag}, #{createBy}, #{createTime}, #{updateBy}, #{updateTime}, #{remark},
mapper.update: update mark_user_notice set read_flag = '1', update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and user_id = #{userId} and read_flag = '0'
update mark_user_notice set read_flag = '1', update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where user_id = #{userId} and read_flag = '0'
mapper.select:
select sum(case when mo.audit_status = '0' then 1 else 0 end) as pendingCount, sum(case when mo.audit_status in ('1','2','3') and date(mo.audit_time) = curdate() then 1 else 0 end) as todayAuditCount, sum(case when mo.audit_status = '1' and date(mo.audit_time) = curdate() then 1 else 0 end) as todayPassCount, sum(case when mo.audit_status = '2' and date(mo.audit_time) = curdate() then 1 else 0 end) as todayRejectCount, sum(case when mo.audit_status = '3' and date(mo.audit_time) = curdate() then 1 else 0 end) as todayReturnCount, sum(case when mo.audit_status in ('1','2','3') then 1 else 0 end) as totalAuditCount, sum(case when mo.audit_status = '1' then 1 else 0 end) as totalPassCount from mark_order mo left join sys_user su on su.user_id = mo.user_id
and ( mo.assigned_agent_id = #{agentId} or (mo.assigned_agent_id is null and su.create_by = #{agentUsername}) or exists ( select 1 from sys_user agent_u inner join sys_user_role aur on aur.user_id = agent_u.user_id inner join sys_role ar on ar.role_id = aur.role_id and ar.role_key in ('agent', 'mark_agent') where agent_u.user_id = #{agentId} and agent_u.del_flag = '0' and agent_u.rel_mark_template is not null and agent_u.rel_mark_template > 0 and su.rel_mark_template = agent_u.rel_mark_template ) or exists ( select 1 from mark_platform_template mpt where mpt.id = su.rel_mark_template and mpt.owner_user_id = #{agentId} and mpt.status = '0' ) )
